PHYSIOTHERAPISTS –  (VIC Regional & Melbourne)

 An outstanding opportunity is now available for dedicated Physiotherapists to join our VIC team. 

Practice Locations:
Bairnsdale, Sale, Traralgon, Morwell, Moe, Leongatha, Wonthaggi, Cowes, Warragul, Drouin, Pakenham, Beaconsfield, Cranbourne, Dandenong, Frankston, Aspendale Gardens, Hampton, Cheltenham, Altona, Point Cook, Drysdale, Deer Park, Moonee Ponds, Blackburn, Rowville, Warrnambool, Portland, Wantirna south. Aged Care across Victoria.

 Who Is PhysioChoice?  

Our evolution from the humble beginnings of a single practice in regional Victoria to 69+ practices across the country has been an amazing journey… and a road we are still travelling. 

Working across Community, Aged Care and Private Practice, PhysioChoice are certainly a leader in their field, with in excess of 400 staff working from both private practice and affiliated Aged Care Facilities and hospitals across Australia. 

Our innovative group is dedicated to offering benchmark assessments, maintenance therapy and rehabilitation.

The Role and Offerings  

With growth, comes opportunity, and the opportunities which PhysioChoice can offer you within the Aged Care and private practice sector are exceptional. 

Core responsibilities within these roles will include: 

Aged Care Assessments, Care Plan development, regular evaluation and incident analysis, Care Plan modification and progression and in-service education. 
Physiotherapy treatments.  
Physiotherapy assessments. 
Exercise prescription and the formulation of Care Plans. 
Implementation of a pain management clinic. 
Correspondence with, and liaison for, residents, families, nursing, medical practitioners, allied health practitioners and equipment suppliers. 
Facilitation of falls prevention workshops, manual handling and other staff education. 
 
 In return for your dedication, enthusiasm and effort you will be rewarded with: 

A generous remuneration package. 
Comprehensive orientation and ongoing support. 
Opportunities for growth and promotion. 
Continuing Education Allowance. 
In house professional development opportunities. 
Relocation Assistance (if required). 
A community of like-minded professionals there to offer continued support and guidance. 
Opportunities to mentor and/or support. 
Great work/life balance	 

 Further Information:  

 We would love to speak to you if you have:
 
A Bachelor of Physiotherapy. 
A current interim certificate
Demonstrable experience in aged care. 
A current National Police Check and evidence of current COVID-19 & Flu Vaccinations 
Exceptional communication skills. 
Ability to work well in a team environment. 
A car and license. 
A passion for the industry, an empathetic nature and a strong ability to build rapport. 
 
 Please visit  www.physiochoice.com.au  for further information and application instructions.

Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson 
Location: Kyabram, VIC 3620 
Tenure: Full-time, permanent
Salary: From $71,481 per year (plus superannuation)
 
Required skills and experience:
•	AQF Certificate III in Agriculture / Dairy Production (or higher equivalent)
•	Three (3) years of recent and relevant work experience

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Kyabram, VIC 3620. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
 
Qualified applicants may apply online.

Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
We are seeking a passionate and nurturing Child Care Worker for an exclusive partnership with a prestigious, community-focused preschool. This role is ideal for an educator who believes in the power of a holistic, play-based approach and values creating a warm, homelike environment for children. The centre prides itself on its beautiful, natural settings and its philosophy that emphasises emotional security, creativity, and foundational learning through exploration. We are looking for a dedicated professional who can contribute to this nurturing atmosphere, design a stimulating program inspired by the Early Years Learning Framework, and build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the wider community. This is a unique opportunity to join a team deeply committed to providing an exceptional early learning experience.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

International SOS is the world's leading medical and security services company, administering the TRICARE Overseas Program (TOP) on behalf of the Defense Health Agency (DHA) for U.S. military members, families, and retirees stationed overseas.

This permanent full time role of a Health Benefits Advisor (HBA) is to provide exceptional customer service and expert beneficiary education as the trusted, in-person healthcare support for the NSA Stirling community helping TRICARE-eligible beneficiaries navigate the Australian healthcare system and access the care they require. 

Key responsibilities
- Provide on-site guidance on TRICARE benefits, eligibility, enrollment, disenrollment, and regional transfers 
- Connect beneficiaries with appropriate specialists, mental health services, and other healthcare resources, explaining referral processes and how to access covered care in Australia
- Support claims and referral queries, providing status updates and resolving issues with the TRICARE Overseas Program Contractor, escalating complex cases as needed
- Lead TRICARE informational sessions for newcomers, in/out processing, pre-separation, retirement, and other community events at NSA Stirling
- Maintain accurate records in applicable Government and Contractor systems
- Handle all beneficiary information in line with HIPAA regulations and Australian privacy requirements

About you
- Minimum 3 years of customer service experience
- Familiarity of the TRICARE Overseas Program (TOP) and the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS) is desirable

- Based in Rockingham / Perth and able to commute to work

Benefits

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications.

About the Role

JBS is currently recruiting an experienced sales promotion officer to join the Southern Operations team (Port Melbourne) in a permanent full-time capacity.

The sales promotion officer is an integral part of the team. This position provides critical and intuitive support to the Southern Sales Team across order entry, production control and monitoring, inventory control and key account maintenance. This role will provide required skills training needed to move into a future role of Domestic/Export Sales Person. Regular Plant visits will be arranged to give a broad understanding of the business. The annual salary for this role is not less than $80,000 plus superannuation.

This opportunity is ideal for any person looking to move into the commercial area of a highly respected, national organization with serious opportunity for growth and development.

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

· Provide general support to the team as required

· Enter new sales and distribute confirmations to customers

· Coordinate and work with production planners for order delivery

· Contribute to the development and implementation of the tactical marketing plan and policies, preparation and execution of marketing objectives and programs, to deliver the business goals in terms of Sales

· Take accountability to ensure effective measures are in place to measure campaign effectiveness for the given products and services, and analyses data regarding the patterns and preferences of customers. Provide recommendations on improving campaign performance and cost efficiencies.

· Assist with reporting and analysis of sales data and market information

· Provide key accounts with production updates and shipment information

· Maintain and grow customer relationships in conjunction with sales team

· Liaise with shipping team on schedules and details for relevant orders

· Maintain and analyze inventory data

· Liaise with sales and customers to develop new specifications and labels

· Build relationships across a range of disciplines for your own personal development and for the execution of sales team strategies

· Support the sales team with marketing and brand activations with customers



About you:

· Tertiary qualifications in Business or Marketing

· Strong computer literacy in excel, word and outlook (intermediate to advanced Excel)

· Excellent written and verbal communication

· Ability to remain calm in difficult situations whilst maintaining a strong customer service focus

· Exceptional ability to prioritise and multi-skill

· Excellent attention to detail

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

· Demonstrated ability to work autonomously as well as within a team environment

· Takes other's perspective's into consideration

· Energetic, passionate and enthusiastic

· Demonstrated focus on system improvement

· Makes self fully available as required

Benefits include (but are not limited to):

· Retail discounts with national partners

· Health insurance discounts on Bupa Health and Medibank Private

What next?

If you’re passionate and want to be a part of the largest meat, pork and salmon manufacturer and producer in Australia, this opportunity may be for you. Apply now!

The ad is valid for 28 days.
